'''Special Edition Dark Side Starter Deck''' is a 60-card [[Special Edition]] starter published by [[Decipher]] in November 1998. MSRP was $12.95. Each deck contains 22 starter-only cards (printed rarity '''F''', one of each title), plus 22 commons, 14 uncommons and 2 rares drawn at random from Special Edition. Those 38 random cards print '''C''', '''U''' or '''R''', the same rarities as Special Edition booster copies. The box also includes [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Rulebook 2.0]] and [[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Glossary 2.0]]. The Light product is [[Special Edition Light Side Starter Deck]]. A display box held 12 decks, 6 per side.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== Card list ==
Each Dark Side starter contains 60 cards. 22 of those cards are the same in every Dark Side starter. The other 38 are random Special Edition commons, uncommons and rares. <ref name="encyc" />
